items.summary: As the 21st Canada-EU summit is set to open Thursday in Montreal, the standoff between Prime Minister Mark Carney and Quebec Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon has culminated in the premier officially withdrawing his personal attendance.

items.title: Cornell faculty to move forward with no-confidence vote over handling of sexual assault allegations
items.summary: Cornell University faculty will meet Wednesday to conclude debate and begin voting on a proposed no-confidence resolution in the university’s administration following widespread frustration over its response to a woman who reported she was gang raped at a campus fraternity house in 2024.

items.title: Suspect wanted after several bikes stolen from downtown Toronto residence
items.summary: Toronto police have released images of a suspect who they say stole bicycles from a downtown residence in the summer.

items.title: ‘I got to hand it to Subaru. They made a good car’: Bear locks itself inside vehicle
items.summary: An Alaskan family says a black bear got trapped in their car early Monday morning, destroying the interior before police rescued it.
